name: prism
description: The PRISM dashboard inside Kiro Crew (the same pages and actions as prism-cli dashboard), codewatch findings, AI spend and setup status for Kiro Crew agents, and a daily digest that speaks only when something changed. Needs prism-cli 1.21.3 or later, which the App Store install sets up with npm.
author: aws-samples
highlights: PRISM page: prism-cli's own dashboard (Dashboard, Security Agent, AccountGuard, Settings) with its Run buttons and confirm dialogs, in a sandboxed frame, from your installed prism-cli
The prism MCP server: prism_status, prism_findings, prism_spend, prism_report, prism_snapshot, prism_dashboard, prism_dashboard_stop, prism_review and prism_setup, served by your own prism-cli mcp
Finds prism-cli installed with nvm or Volta even when Kiro Crew's PATH does not include it
prism-fix-findings skill: an agent checks the latest codewatch review before it finishes, fixes real issues in at most 2 rounds and reports the rest
prism-daily-digest: a script cron with no model call that notifies only on a new high finding, spend over your threshold, or a setup item that broke
useCases: When you start the day, open the PRISM page to see which repos got new codewatch findings, open a scan report, or run a setup step or a Security Agent review from Settings without leaving Kiro Crew
When an agent finishes a code change in a repo with codewatch, the prism-fix-findings skill has it call prism_review and fix the real high and medium findings before it reports done
When you want to know what codewatch flagged across your repos, ask a chat to call prism_findings or prism_status instead of opening the dashboard
When you want a heads-up without watching a page, let prism-daily-digest run at 09:00 and tell you only about new high findings, a setup regression, or spend over your threshold
configuration: Install from the App Store: the install checks for prism-cli 1.21.3 or later and, if it is missing or older, runs npm install -g @prism-d1/cli@^1.21.3 (Node.js 22 or later, no sudo). Or: npm install -g @prism-d1/cli@latest && prism-cli enable kirocrew
Trust the app when you enable it; Kiro Crew registers nothing from a third-party app until you do
Optional: set spendThreshold and cliPath in the app's data/config.json (see the README)
Optional: AI spend on the page and in the digest comes from codeburn; set it up from the page (Settings, prism-cli enable codeburn), which asks first

crons.name: prism-daily-digest
crons.message: PRISM daily digest (script, no model call)

spendThreshold.description: Notify once a day when today's AI spend (codeburn, in its currency) is above this. Unset or null: off.

cliPath.description: Absolute path to prism-cli, when it is not found on PATH or in the nvm, Volta, ~/.local/bin or npm prefix folders.
